name: Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace
introDiscord: A palace of prism coral divides moonlight into colors unknown above the sea.
introTwitch: A palace of prism coral divides moonlight into colors unknown above the sea.

spectrum-gate.name: Spectrum Gate
spectrum-gate.prompt: The spectrum gate scatters shifting bands across three equally radiant halls.

left.message: Within Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace, the left path from Spectrum Gate reveals a hidden Fae offering vessel.

right.message: The water folds around Moonlit Prism Serpent, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

forward.message: Beyond Spectrum Gate, a restorative current shaped by Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace gathers in a quiet basin.
forward.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

refraction-hall.name: Refraction Hall
refraction-hall.prompt: Refraction pillars multiply every movement around three mirrored passages.

left.message: A quiet recess beyond Refraction Hall preserves a broken celestial instrument, but offers no material reward.

right.message: Within Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace, the right path from Refraction Hall reveals a hidden Moonkeeper cache.

forward.message: The water folds around Moonlit Prism Serpent, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

prismcoil-arcade.name: Prismcoil Arcade
prismcoil-arcade.prompt: A prismcoil arcade curves through color as three exits trade places in the light.

left.message: The water folds around Moonlit Prism Serpent, revealing the creature as it claims the passage.

right.message: Beyond Prismcoil Arcade, a restorative current shaped by Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace gathers in a quiet basin.
right.fullHpMessage: The restorative magic of Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace finds no wounds to mend. You are already at full HP.

forward.message: Within Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace, the forward path from Prismcoil Arcade reveals a hidden moon-shell coffer.

boss-antechamber.name: Empress Kaleidoscope
boss-antechamber.prompt: A powerful presence shifts beyond the final threshold while the surrounding reef falls still.

bossPromptDiscord:
You reach Empress Kaleidoscope. The water tightens around an unseen guardian whose presence fills the chamber.
Use /yes to continue or /no to retreat for now.
bossPromptTwitch: Empress Kaleidoscope: An unseen guardian stirs beyond the threshold. Use !yes to continue or !no to retreat.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Empress Kaleidoscope. The hidden guardian remains beyond the threshold.

boss.revealText: The chamber answers with a surge of reef magic. Prismatic Coil Empress reveals itself!

completionText: Prismatic Coil Empress yields to the returning current. Moonlit Prism Serpent Palace settles into a quieter rhythm, and another route through the Moonlit Reef becomes clear.
